BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Expensive core with Paul George. Below tax line, aiming to reset repeater tax. Stand-pat.

CLE.note: Expensive core (Mitchell, Mobley, Allen). Under aprons, but limited flexibility. Stand-pat.

DET.note: Young core with significant cap space. Duren's RFA decision is key. Buyer/swing.

MIA.note: Giannis Antetokounmpo acquired. Wiggins exercised option. Limited cap space, but strong contender.

GSW.note: Expensive veteran core (Curry, Butler, Green). Limited cap flexibility, likely stand-pat or minor moves.

HOU.note: Young core with Durant. Fred VanVleet exercised option. Under aprons, Eason RFA deal could tighten cap. Buyer.

MIN.note: Under first apron, but large contracts (Gobert, Randle) are trade chips. DiVincenzo returns 2027-28.

OKC.note: Young, talented core. Over second apron, limiting flexibility. Potential for minor depth moves.

POR.note: Lillard returns from Achilles. Morant acquired. Young core developing, but large contracts limit flexibility.

SAS.note: Young core (Wemby, Castle, Harper) on cheap deals. Good cap flexibility for trades. Buyer.
